_comment: Two rocks in blotches rather than mingled to a speckle -- you can see where one stops.
It replaces `finely`, which asked for the *fine* end of the mingling and became a word for the
default when that end became the default (walked 2026-07-27: two materials should read as one
mottled stone unless somebody says otherwise). So the word that is worth having is the one for the
unusual answer, and this is it.
It declares the landmass because mingling is a landform's parameter and nothing else has one; when
something else grows a mixture, this word reaches it with no edit.
